ui.profileCode.title: 配置码
Configuration code
ui.profileCode.importDesc: 粘贴他人的配置码，校验通过后另存并使用
Paste a shared code to validate, save separately and apply
ui.profileCode.offlineHint: 离线配置码，可直接复制分享；不需要账号或服务器
Self-contained offline codes: copy and share without an account or server
ui.profileCode.identityHint: 每套配置有独立身份；可分享内容不变，配置码就不变。修改参数后请重新复制，旧码仍保留旧参数。
Each configuration has its own identity. Its code stays identical while portable content is unchanged. Copy again after editing; old codes retain the old parameters.
ui.profileCode.nameHint: 可不填；重名时自动添加后缀
Optional; duplicate names receive a suffix
ui.profileCode.independentHint: 导入会创建独立配置并立即使用，不覆盖现有配置；名称相同会自动编号。
Import creates and applies a separate local configuration. Existing configurations are preserved; duplicate names are numbered.
ui.profileCode.privacyHint: 只分享模块状态、快捷键、收藏及可移植参数。API Key、服务器地址、个人头像、玩家 ID、私信、聊天内容、脚本、任务文本与本地路径不会分享。
Shares module states, key bindings, favorites and portable parameters. API keys, server addresses, avatars, player IDs, private/chat text, scripts, task text and local paths are excluded.
ui.profileCode.localResourceHint: 图片、视频、字体文件、音色及独立粒子／建筑方案不包含在码内，需另行传递。通用语言与字体选择保留本机设置；投屏、世界内面板、粒子方案、图片背景与披风导入后保持关闭。

Images, videos, font files, voices and separate particle/building plans must be shared separately. Global language and fonts remain local. App casting, the world panel, particle plans, image backgrounds and capes stay off after import.
ui.profileCode.validated: 已检查 %s 个模块，其中 %s 个开启
ui.profileCode.ready: 配置码已生成，共 %s 个字符；请复制完整内容
Code generated: %s characters. Copy the entire code.
ui.profileCode.valid: 配置码有效，可以导入使用
Code is valid and ready to import
ui.profileCode.tooLarge: 配置码过长或解压内容超出限制，请重新导出
The code or its decompressed content exceeds the size limit. Export it again.
ui.profileCode.version: 配置码格式或版本不匹配，请粘贴以 CP1. 开头的完整代码
Unsupported code format/version. Paste the complete code beginning with CP1.
ui.profileCode.invalid: 配置码内容无效，请检查是否完整复制、是否多了空格
Invalid code content. Check that it is complete and has no extra spaces.
ui.profileCode.checksum: 配置码校验不通过，内容可能缺失或被修改，请重新复制
The code checksum does not match. Copy it again; some content is missing or changed.
ui.profileCode.incompatible: 配置码包含本版本不支持的功能或参数，请使用相同版本
The code contains unsupported modules or settings. Use the same mod version.
ui.profileCode.privateContent: 配置码包含不可分享的字段或无效文本，请由原作者重新导出
The code contains private/non-portable fields or invalid text. Ask its author to export it again.
ui.profileCode.saveFailed: 无法保存或使用配置，请检查配置文件夹是否可写
Could not save or apply the configuration. Check that the configuration folder is writable.
ui.profileCode.deleteHint: 删除当前使用的配置后，会切换到其他有效配置；没有其他配置时会新建默认配置。已分享出去的配置码仍可导入。
Deleting the active configuration switches to another valid one, or creates fresh defaults if none remain. Previously shared codes can still be imported.
ui.profileCode.deleteFailed: 配置未删除，请检查文件夹权限或是否已被移除
Configuration was not deleted. Check folder permissions or whether it was already removed.
